p: Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A trap / hex bar, a hexagonal steel frame bar that the lifter stands inside, with two parallel knurled handles on opposite sides of the hexagon, raised high handles as an option, and long loading sleeves protruding from each end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An axle / fat bar, a thick un-knurled steel bar about 50 mm in diameter with no rotating sleeves, the whole bar the same thickness end to end, loaded with plates near each end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of landmine handles, a steel sleeve that slides onto the end of a barbell, fitted with a choice of grips: a pair of neutral handles in a V shape, a wide T handle or two parallel overhead press handles.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A half rack / squat stands, a pair of tall upright steel posts on a rectangular base with J-hooks holding a barbell, short spotter arms projecting forwards and a pull-up bar connecting the tops, open at the front.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A Smith machine, a tall steel frame with a barbell fixed to vertical guide rods so it runs straight up and down, with hooks on the bar that rotate into slots on the uprights, plate pegs on the bar and adjustable safety stops at the base.
Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A flat bench, a long narrow padded flat bench on a sturdy three-point steel frame at knee height, with no uprights.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A shoulder press bench, a near-upright padded backrest with a small seat, tall steel uprights behind the head holding a barbell overhead and a footrest platform for a spotter at the back.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A deadlift platform, a large square wooden centre panel flanked on both sides by thick black rubber mats, raised slightly above the floor, with a loaded barbell resting on the rubber sections.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of rack lever arms, a pair of long steel lever arms that pin into the lower holes of a power rack upright at each side and pivot upwards, each with a handle near the free end and a short loading sleeve for plates.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of kettlebells, a row of cast iron ball-shaped weights with flat bottoms and thick looped handles on top, coloured by weight, from small to large.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A high pulley, a single upright steel tower with a weight stack in a guarded frame and one pulley mounted at the top, the cable hanging down with a straight bar attached.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A cable crossover (two stacks), a wide steel frame with two separate weight stack towers on either side joined by a crossbar with a pull-up bar, each tower with a pulley that slides up and down a vertical rail.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A triceps rope, a thick braided nylon rope folded in two with a steel snap-link ring at the centre and a rubber stopper ball at each end.
Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A d-handle, a single D-shaped steel stirrup with a rotating rubber or knurled grip and a ring at the top for clipping to a cable.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A plate-loaded pulley (DIY), a single steel pulley clamped to the top crossmember of a rack, with a steel cable running over it down to a vertical loading pin with plates at the bottom and a handle at the other end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A captain's chair, a tall steel station with a padded back rest, two padded forearm rests with handles at elbow height so the legs hang free, and often a pull-up bar on top.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A treadmill, a motorised running machine with a long flat rubber belt deck, side rails, front handlebars and an upright console with a screen.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A SkiErg, a tall narrow upright frame with a flywheel housing at the top, two handles on cords dropping from pulleys, and an optional floor platform.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A recumbent bike, a stationary bike with a low wide seat with a padded backrest, pedals in front of the user at hip height, side handles and a console on an upright.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An adaptive motion trainer, a large cardio machine with two foot pedals hanging from swinging arms, moving handles, and a curved upright frame, allowing the stride length to change freely.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A stepper, a compact machine with two independent pedals that move up and down on hydraulic arms, side handrails and a small console.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A recumbent cross-trainer, a seated machine with a large swivelling padded chair with armrests, two pedals in front and two long moving handles linked to the pedals, with a small console.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of battle ropes, a long heavy braided rope about 4 cm thick looped around a steel anchor point fixed to the floor, with both ends lying parallel on the floor with grip sleeves.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A sandbag, a heavy cylindrical bag made of thick black cordura nylon with several side and end grab handles, stuffed tight and resting on the floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An agility ladder / hurdles, a flat strap ladder with yellow plastic rungs laid on artificial turf, next to a row of small plastic step-over hurdles and some marker cones.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A resisted push sled (wheeled), a compact wheeled push sled with a central resistance unit and dial, two vertical push handles and a low frame on four wheels that can be used on any floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A mini trampoline / rebounder, a small round trampoline about 1 m across on six short legs, with a black jumping mat and a padded cover over the springs, and an optional T-shaped handle bar.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of atlas stones, a set of round grey concrete spheres of increasing size resting on the floor, next to a square steel loading platform at chest height.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A circus dumbbell, a large single dumbbell with a very thick rotating handle about 6 cm across and two big hollow spherical heads, one with a loading port, standing on its end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of Fingal's fingers, a set of three long steel poles of increasing length, each hinged at its base on a ground bracket and lying flat on the floor, ready to be flipped upright.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of dip bars, a pair of parallel steel bars about 50 cm apart and 1.2 m high on a sturdy free-standing frame, with knurled or rubber grips.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of wall bars, a tall wooden frame about 2.4 m high fixed flat to a wall, with evenly spaced round wooden rungs running from floor to near the ceiling.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An ab wheel, a small rubber-tyred wheel about 18 cm across with a central axle and two short foam-covered handles sticking out either side.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A climbing rope, a thick braided natural fibre rope about 4 cm across hanging vertically from a steel beam high above, reaching down to the gym floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of grip trainers, a pair of steel torsion spring hand grippers with knurled aluminium handles, beside a small steel pinch block with a loading pin.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of ankle weights, a pair of padded fabric cuffs filled with sand or iron pellets, with hook-and-loop straps that wrap around the ankle.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A massage gun, a handheld percussive massage device shaped like a hairdryer, with a rubber grip handle, a motor body and a round foam head on a short shaft.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A stretching machine, a compact steel frame with a padded seat at the front, padded knee pads below and two curved handlebars above on a ladder of grip positions, used to sit and pull into assisted stretches.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A Pilates reformer, a long low wooden or aluminium bed frame with a padded sliding carriage on rails, shoulder blocks, an adjustable footbar at one end, springs underneath and two ropes with hand loops on pulleys.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An incline bodyweight trainer, a long padded glide board running on rails along an inclined steel column that adjusts in height, with a squat footplate at the base and two cable handles over pulleys at the top.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A vibration plate, a low flat platform with a rubber-covered top, a central upright column with handles and a small display console at waist height.
